title: Outbound network policy
objective: Reach an allowlisted host, then try to reach an owned canary by name, by raw IP and through a redirect from the allowed host.
limitation: Uses owned local endpoints only. Zero canary hits shows these three routes were blocked in this configuration; it does not prove every egress path is closed. The default profile is expected to allow egress, so an unexpected observation there documents the default posture rather than a defect.

argv:
import json, urllib.request
try:
    urllib.request.urlopen('<<canary_url>>', timeout=3)
    reached = True
except Exception:
    reached = False
print(json.dumps({'reached': reached}))

import json, urllib.request
try:
    urllib.request.urlopen('<<canary_ip_url>>', timeout=3)
    reached = True
except Exception:
    reached = False
print(json.dumps({'reached': reached}))

print(json.dumps({'reached': reached}))
